$comment: Per-agent user-scope ~/.claude.json. claude-peers + telegram are loaded via plugin discovery (enabledPlugins in managed-settings.json), so no MCP entry is needed for them here. Only saga-mcp remains as an SSE MCP server (separate broker, not yet plugin-ised). The hasCompletedOnboarding / bypassPermissionsModeAccepted / hasTrustDialogAccepted flags pre-acknowledge claude-code's first-run TUI dialogs so the agent can boot headless under systemd. Without them claude shows theme picker → workspace trust → bypass-permissions warning and exits 1 when no TTY input arrives.
